name: Dumbbell Overhead Press

instructions.description: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Use an overhand grip with your palms facing forward and your elbows slightly out to the sides.
Brace your core and gently squeeze your glutes to stabilize your body. Keep your chest upright and avoid leaning backward or arching your lower back.

Press both dumbbells straight upward in a controlled, vertical path until your arms are fully extended overhead. As the dumbbells reach the top, gently move your head forward so that your body is aligned directly underneath the weights.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height, keeping the weights under control and avoiding letting them drift too far forward or backward.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Dumbbell Overhead Press — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Dumbbell Overhead Press — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Keep your core and glutes engaged throughout the movement to stabilize your body.
Press the dumbbells vertically, rather than moving them forward as you press.
Avoid arching your lower back or flaring your ribs to help the weights overhead.
Focus on smooth, controlled repetitions rather than using momentum.
